definitions.explanation: the emotional state or feeling of being lonely or desolate

examples.japanese: {寂|さび}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寂|さび}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
examples.english: To endure the sadness of parting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}{暮|ぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寂|さび}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}らわす→紛らわす：08206_magirawasu⟧。
examples.english: To distract oneself from the loneliness of living alone.
